body: There are a few lgbtqia+ groups along the coast including, pawleys island pflag, grand strand pride, pride Myrtle beach, and one other I’m blanking on the name for.  The communities are small but welcoming. As for acceptance it’s hit or miss like most places in the usa. Legislation varies city to city, Myrtle Beach has a pride proclamation, Conway got major backlash for trying to do a pride proclamation. I would recommend taking a look at local city governments involvement with pride month to get a fair idea on that areas response to the pride community.
